As you publish more articles and rewrite, links update automatically. Links include ?utm_source (replaced per site on publish).

plan.bulkHelp:
Runs the whole pipeline for EVERY article in the plan: research → write → score SEO/AEO/GEO, then saves each as a draft to review before publishing.
- Skips articles that already exist so you do not waste quota.
- Persistent queue: it keeps going even if you close the tab (Resume button), and you can retry failed ones.
- Uses your own AI key, so it counts toward your quota; it stops with an error when the quota runs out.

connections.empty: No sites yet. Click "Add connection" to connect WordPress, Wix or Shopify.
connections.label: Friendly name
connections.guideWordpress: In WordPress: Users → Profile → Application Passwords to create an app password (not your login password).
connections.guideWix: Get an API key at manage.wix.com → Settings → API Keys; you also need the site's Site ID.
connections.guideShopify:
Get a Shopify Admin API access token:
1) Shopify admin → Settings → Apps and sales channels → Develop apps (click "Allow custom app development" if hidden).
2) Create an app → name it (e.g. "SEO-GEO").
3) Open the app → Configuration → Admin API integration → Configure scopes.
4) Enable CONTENT scopes: check write_content and read_content (under "Store content" - covers blogs, articles, pages). There is no item literally called "Blog/Article". Save.
5) API credentials tab → Install app → copy the "Admin API access token" (starts with shpat_) and paste it below.
connections.guideHaravan:
How to get a Haravan Access Token:
1) Haravan admin → Apps → Private apps → Create app.
2) Enable Content permissions: read_content + write_content (blogs/articles).
3) Save and copy the Access Token into the field below.
4) Store URL: your shop domain (e.g. your-store.myharavan.com). Leave Blog ID empty to use the first blog.
connections.guideSapo:
How to get Sapo API credentials:
1) Sapo admin → Configuration → Private apps → Create app.
2) Enable read_content + write_content (blogs/articles).
3) Copy the API key + API secret into the fields below.
4) Store domain like your-store.mysapo.net. Leave Blog ID empty to use the first blog.

intGuide.pagespeed:
1) Open Google Cloud Console (link above) and sign in with Google.
2) Create a project: click the project picker at the top → New Project → name it → Create → select that project.
3) Enable the API: open "Enable PageSpeed Insights API" (link above) → click Enable.
4) Create a key: ☰ menu → APIs & Services → Credentials → + CREATE CREDENTIALS → API key → Copy (key looks like AIzaSy…).
5) (Recommended) Edit API key → API restrictions → Restrict key → check "PageSpeed Insights API" → Save.
6) Paste the key into the field below and click Save.

Free (~25,000 requests/day), no Billing required. A new key may take 1–2 minutes to activate.
intGuide.perplexity:
1) Sign in to perplexity.ai.
2) Go to Settings → API (perplexity.ai/settings/api).
3) Add some credit (the API is pay-as-you-go).
4) Click 'Generate' / 'Create Key' to create an API key.
5) Copy the key (looks like pplx-...) and paste it below.

articleSettings.subtitle: Replacement rules applied when AI writes/optimizes
articleSettings.intro: These rules automatically replace text in articles created or optimized by AI (e.g. “-” → “-”, or “ai” → “AI”). Add your own below.
articleSettings.empty: No rules yet. Add a rule or use a quick example below.

articleSettings.pipelineHelp: When on, the editor shows a blueprint step (script/outline/keywords) before writing. When off, write directly with AI.
articleSettings.schemaHelp: Adds Article + FAQ/HowTo schema so Google and AI engines understand and cite your content (boosts AEO/GEO). Some CMS may strip script tags; works best on WordPress.
articleSettings.schemaLogoHelp: Public http(s) image URL, used as the publisher logo.
articleSettings.aiRoutingDesc: Choose the default AI + model for each content step. Leave "Auto" to use the default AI; you can still change it at run time.
articleSettings.maxTokensTitle: Max article length when AI writes (max_tokens)
articleSettings.maxTokensDesc: Caps output tokens each time AI writes, optimizes, or localizes an article. Applies to the editor too.
articleSettings.maxTokensAuto: Set to Auto: the system chooses based on article length (recommended).
articleSettings.maxTokensGuide2: Leaving 0 (Auto) is best for most. If long articles get cut off mid-way, raise to 12,000–16,000.
articleSettings.maxTokensGuide3: max_tokens is only a CEILING - you pay for tokens actually used, so a high value costs no extra. Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek max ~8,000; OpenAI (gpt-4o) up to 16,000. Above a model’s limit, the system lowers it automatically.
articleSettings.taskAnalysisHelp: Choose the AI and model used for the analysis and keyword research step. Leave blank (Automatic) if you want the system to pick the best available provider that has a key.
articleSettings.taskBlueprintHelp: Choose the AI and model used for building the outline and content structure of the article. Stronger models usually produce a more logical layout. Leave it on Automatic if you are not sure what to pick.
articleSettings.taskWriteHelp: Choose the AI and model used for writing the full content. This is the most important step for text quality, so consider the best model you have. Leave it on Automatic if you want the system to decide.
articleSettings.maxTokensLabelHelp: A token is the unit the AI uses to count text (roughly 1 token is close to 0.7 Vietnamese words). This number limits the maximum length of each article the AI creates. Set 0 to let the system choose; set it higher for longer articles, but that costs more in AI fees.
articleSettings.schemaToggleHelp: JSON-LD is a hidden block of data that helps Google and AI tools clearly understand the article (article type, author, brand) and makes it easier to display nicely in search results. Turn this on to automatically insert this data when publishing.
articleSettings.schemaOrgHelp: The name of the organization or brand behind the article. This name is written into the structured data so search engines know who publishes the content.
articleSettings.schemaAuthorHelp: The author name shown in the article's structured data. Naming the author clearly helps build trust with Google and AI tools when they cite your article.

fix.ai_bots: In robots.txt, don't Disallow the AI bots you want to be cited by (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended…).

fix.ai_jsonld: Add JSON-LD (Article, Organization, FAQ…) so AI can understand and cite your content.
fix.ai_entity: Add Organization schema with sameAs (Wikipedia/Wikidata/social links) to strengthen your entity.
fix.ai_author: State the author with bio/expertise; add Person/author schema.
fix.ai_freshness: Add dateModified to schema and show a last-updated date.
fix.ai_llms: Consider adding /llms.txt describing your content for LLMs (an emerging standard).
fix.ai_rss: Provide an RSS/Atom feed so machines and AI can follow new content.
fix.seo_https: Install an SSL certificate and serve the site over HTTPS.
fix.seo_canonical_host: Pick one (www or non-www) and 301-redirect the other to it.
fix.seo_robots: Review robots.txt and remove Disallow rules blocking important pages.
fix.seo_sitemap: Create an XML sitemap and declare it in robots.txt.
fix.seo_404: Make missing pages return a real 404 (avoid soft-404s).
fix.seo_headers: Enable HSTS and gzip/brotli compression on the server/CDN.
fix.seo_noindex: Remove noindex from the homepage (meta robots / X-Robots-Tag).
fix.seo_canonical: Add a self-referencing canonical tag to each page.
fix.seo_viewport: Add a viewport meta tag to make the page mobile-friendly.
fix.seo_hreflang: If multilingual, add symmetric hreflang between translations.
fix.op_title: Make sure every page has a descriptive title tag.
fix.op_title_dup: Write a unique title for each page.
fix.op_meta: Add a 120–155 character meta description per page.
fix.op_meta_dup: Write a unique meta description for each page.
fix.op_h1: Each page should have exactly one H1.
fix.op_images_alt: Add descriptive alt text to images.
fix.op_broken_links: Fix or remove internal links returning 4xx/5xx.
fix.aeo_faq: Add an FAQ block + FAQPage schema to win featured snippets/PAA.
fix.aeo_howto: For tutorials, add HowTo schema with the steps.
fix.aeo_breadcrumb: Add BreadcrumbList schema to clarify site structure.
fix.aeo_twitter: Add a twitter:card tag for nice share previews.

socialReport.subtitle: Analyze Facebook pages & groups, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, YouTube and Shopee products with real data + AI
socialReport.titleHelp:
Pick a channel (Facebook page, TikTok, YouTube, or Overall across platforms): the system collects posts/videos, ads (Ads Library) and comments, computes engagement metrics, then uses AI to analyze brand positioning, brand voice, target audience, content pillars, content formulas, ad strategy, marketing funnel, strengths/weaknesses, action recommendations - plus cross-channel comparison for the Overall report.
Requires a data-collection connection in Connections and at least one AI API key.
For a public Facebook Group: collects posts + per-post comments and group metrics, then AI analyzes hot topics, member insights and content/seeding opportunities.
For Instagram/Threads: collects posts (Instagram incl. Reels + transcripts) and comments, analyzed as a brand channel. For a Shopee product: collects product info + customer reviews; AI analyzes the listing, buyer insights and improvement/sales-content suggestions.

landingAudit.title: Landing page SEO / AEO / GEO audit
landingAudit.subtitle: Upload a single HTML file (with inline CSS/JS). We analyze the static HTML — exactly what AI bots read — score SEO/AEO/GEO, show what to fix and how, and preview the page safely.
landingAudit.needFile: Please upload or paste an HTML file first.
landingAudit.naNote: This is a single-file audit, so site-level checks don't apply: robots.txt, sitemap, HTTP→HTTPS redirect, canonical host and PageSpeed. Publish the page and use the website audit for those.
landingAudit.aiHint: Pick an AI to get a detailed, step-by-step fix guide for each issue.

c.lp_h1: Exactly one H1 stating the value proposition
c.lp_faq: FAQ schema (if the page has Q&A)
c.lp_heading_order: Logical heading order (H2 sections, no skipped levels)
c.lp_noindex: Page is indexable (not set to noindex)
c.lp_lists: Has a list or table (extractable format)
c.lp_depth: Enough content depth for AI to cite

fix.lp_title: Add a concise <title> (10–60 chars) that names the offer and a keyword.
fix.lp_meta: Add a meta description of 80–160 characters summarizing the main benefit.
fix.lp_h1: Use exactly one <h1> that clearly states the page's main value proposition.
fix.lp_img_alt: Give every meaningful a descriptive alt attribute.
fix.lp_mixed: Load all resources over https:// to avoid mixed-content blocking on https pages.
fix.lp_og: Add og:title, og:description and og:image for rich social/link previews.
fix.lp_twitter: Add <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image"> and related tags.
fix.lp_cta: Add a clear call-to-action button (sign up, buy, contact…).
fix.lp_contact: Add a visible contact: a mailto: or tel: link.
fix.lp_norender: Content depends on JavaScript; AI bots usually don't run JS. Render key text in the static HTML (SSR/SSG).
fix.lp_jsonld: Add JSON-LD (Organization, Product, FAQ…) so AI can understand and cite the page.
fix.lp_entity: Add Organization schema with sameAs (social/Wikipedia links) to strengthen your entity.
fix.lp_faq: If the page answers common questions, add an FAQ block + FAQPage schema.
fix.lp_facts: Include concrete numbers (stats, prices, results) that AI can quote.
fix.lp_heading_order: Structure content with H2 sections under the H1; don't skip levels (H1→H3).
fix.lp_charset: Add <meta charset="utf-8"> as the first tag in <head>.
fix.lp_img_opt: Add width & height to images (prevents layout shift), use loading="lazy" for below-the-fold images, and serve WebP/AVIF.
fix.lp_semantic: Wrap content in semantic landmarks: <main>, plus <header>/<footer>/<nav>.
fix.lp_noindex: Remove the noindex robots meta so the page can be indexed by Google and AI engines.
fix.lp_breadcrumb: Add BreadcrumbList schema to clarify the page's place in the site.
fix.lp_schema_rich: Add Product/Service/Offer schema (with price, availability) for rich results and AI understanding.
fix.lp_review: Add Review or AggregateRating schema to show star ratings and build trust.
fix.lp_video: Your page has a video but no VideoObject schema — add it so search/AI can index the video.
fix.lp_lists: Add at least one list (<ul>/<ol>) or table — easy for snippets and AI to extract.
fix.lp_depth: Add more substantive copy so AI has enough content to quote (aim for a few hundred words).
fix.lp_jsonld_valid: One of your JSON-LD blocks has a syntax error — engines ignore invalid schema. Validate the JSON.
fix.lp_author: State the author (byline) and add Person/author schema to signal expertise (E-E-A-T).
fix.lp_freshness: Show a published/updated date and add datePublished/dateModified to schema.
fix.lp_citations: Link out to authoritative sources — GEO rewards content that cites evidence.

tutorial.title: Welcome!
tutorial.step1Body: This tool helps you write SEO- and GEO-ready content and publish it straight to your website. Just a few steps to your first article.
tutorial.step2Title: Step 1: Add an AI API key
tutorial.step2Body: Go to Connections and paste an API key from an AI provider (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini or DeepSeek). It's required to write and score articles.
tutorial.step3Body: Add a connection to WordPress, Wix, Shopify, Haravan, Sapo or Google Sheet to publish with a single click.
tutorial.step4Body: Open the Editor, enter a topic for the AI to draft, then watch the SEO/GEO scores and follow the tips to improve them.
tutorial.step5Body: Need more detail? Open the User guide in the left menu anytime. Happy creating!

backlink.title: Cross-site backlinks
backlink.subtitle: Link genuinely related posts across your connected sites (two-way, with utm_source).
backlink.graphEmpty: No posts to draw the graph yet.
backlink.noSuggestions: No pairs are related enough to backlink. We only link genuinely related content.
backlink.noPosts: No posts loaded from your sites. Check your CMS connections.
backlink.emptyIntro: Scan posts across your connected sites so AI can find related pairs and suggest two-way backlinks.
backlink.utmNote: Every backlink gets a utm_source of the source site's domain for tracking.
backlink.relatedOnly: We only suggest links when content is genuinely related (score ≥ 70) and only between different sites — never indiscriminate linking.
backlink.skipNoContent: Couldn't read the post content (e.g. Wix) — skipping this direction.
backlink.skipNoAnchor: No suitable anchor phrase — skipping this direction.
backlink.skipAnchorNotFound: Anchor phrase not found in the post — skipping this direction.
backlink.skipAlready: The post already links here — skipping.
